usage: policy for libraries directly referenced in code that have few interested users
name: Open source directly referenced in code should be widely used
description: Utilizing libraries that have very few users downloading or interested may be risky.
detailedDescription: Open source libraries with a large number of users are libraries that are more likely to be stable. This makes them preferable to use from a security perspective.

args.name: interested
args.label: Stars count
args.tooltip: Minimum number of stars. Policy violation occurs only when all arguments (forks, stars, downloads if available) are violated.

args.name: downloads
args.label: Downloads count
args.tooltip: Minimum number of downloads. Policy violation occurs only when all arguments (forks, stars, downloads if available) are violated.

args.name: forks
args.label: Forks count
args.tooltip: Minimum number of forks. Policy violation occurs only when all arguments (forks, stars, downloads if available) are violated.
